title: Multi-Cloud Active-Active Disaster Recovery RPO=0 / RTO<30s
subtitle: Cross-Cloud Network Partition Arbitration, Dual-Provider BGP and Reversible Failover
problem_statement: A critical financial infrastructure must survive the catastrophic total collapse of an entire primary cloud provider (e.g. AWS us-east-1 outage) with zero data loss (RPO = 0) and automatic traffic redirection in under 30 seconds (RTO < 30s) across AWS and Google Cloud.

faded_bug.description: Two-party arbitration without neutral third-party witness causes split-brain active-active data corruption during WAN partition.

studio_1_runtime.correct_fix_diff:
+ // Require 3-party independent quorum (AWS + GCP + Azure/Equinix witness) before failover
+ if !quorumWitness.ConfirmIsolated(failedCloud) { return abortFailover() }

invariants.description: RPO must strictly equal 0 (zero lost transactions) and RTO < 30s during total cloud failure.

probing_ladder.stage_1_validation: Explain the physical mechanics of synchronous replication across AWS DirectConnect and GCP Interconnect. What is the minimum network latency imposed by the speed of light in fiber?
probing_ladder.stage_2_tightening: If the inter-cloud WAN link is severed, but both AWS and GCP are internally healthy, how do you prevent Split-Brain (both clouds accepting contradictory writes)?
probing_ladder.stage_3_adversarial: AWS begins flapping (up 10 seconds, down 5 seconds). How does hysteresis dampening prevent flapping failovers that destroy database consistency?
probing_ladder.stage_4_squeeze: Running identical 100% compute capacity in two clouds doubles infrastructure costs. Design an asymmetric warm-standby architecture that satisfies RTO < 30s.

counter_probes.counter_question: Asynchronous replication implies data is acknowledged to the client before it reaches the secondary cloud. If the primary cloud vaporizes, where does the in-flight un-replicated data go?
counter_probes.expected_staff_answer: It is lost forever. RPO=0 mathematically requires synchronous quorum acknowledgment (at least 2 of 3 nodes/regions confirming disk commit) before acknowledging the client.
